description: Search for an Okta group by its name and return its ID.
command: "$OKTA_URL/api/v1/groups" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; text=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(text) if text.strip() else []; print(json.dumps({"id": data[0]["id"]} if isinstance(data, list) and data else {"error": "Not found"}))'
questions: What is the name of the Okta group to search for?*
